$comment: Mirrors libs/utils/src/meeting-platform.ts (resolveMeetingPlatform: ids, labels, host matching) as the code behaves today. Dot colours live in tokens/domain.css as --icon-platform-<id>; the vendor hex values in libs/utils are not design tokens. Proposal, not current behaviour: accept only https links — a libs/utils issue. Rules: MDS-DOM-03, MDS-COL-06, MDS-TOK-04.

fields.id: the MeetingPlatformId the resolver returns; also the --icon-platform-<id> suffix
fields.label: the label the resolver returns, shown as the chip's text
fields.hostSuffixes: the hosts the resolver matches, with every subdomain
fields.dotToken: the token that colours the chip's 8px decorative dot
fields.codeLabel: the label the resolver returns for an unknown host (empty: the caller decides)
fields.uiLabel: what the UI shows for an unknown host
fields.showHost: true: the link's host is shown too, in dir="ltr"

match: hostname of new URL(link.includes('://') ? link : 'https://' + link), lower-cased; a platform matches when hostname === suffix || hostname.endsWith('.' + suffix); platforms are tried in the order listed and the first match wins; any scheme the URL parser accepts; an empty or missing link, or a parse failure, is unknown (so is a scheme-less link that contains '://' later, e.g. in its query)
